subject.title: fix(chat): preserve explicit current-source sends in Control UI history

question: Should Control UI history trust the outbound runner’s structured `current-source` marker as authoritative proof that an explicit send belongs to the active session?
rationale: The implementation is internally consistent and well tested, but this choice defines a session-history association boundary whose false positives could display a send in the wrong conversation history.

options.title: Accept the outbound marker
options.body: Confirm the resolved route tuple as canonical and merge after refreshing the draft and final exact-head gates.

options.title: Use delivery-mirror identity instead
options.body: Require the history projector to derive association from an existing canonical delivery-mirror or transcript identity rather than introducing a separate marker.

options.title: Pause for unified projection design
options.body: Hold this slice until explicit sends and subagent lifecycle deliveries share one broader channel-to-session history association contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the outbound marker
recommendation.body: Confirm the resolved route tuple as canonical and merge after refreshing the draft and final exact-head gates.
